what: blaze-profile gains a normal dependency on blaze-graph: add `blaze-graph.workspace = true` to [dependencies] of crates/blaze-profile/Cargo.toml, after `arrow-schema.workspace = true` (sorted). Why: blaze-profile::install now registers its per-thread span state with blaze_graph::sched::fiber::carry (so a fiber job's open spans move with it across a wait) and observes the driver's switches (blaze_graph::sched::fiber::observe) to record the `switches` table. No cycle: blaze-graph and its dependencies do not depend on blaze-profile. Uses in crates/blaze-profile/src/lib.rs (carry_with_fiber_jobs, observed) and the flight test a_span_opened_before_a_wait_closes_after_its_job_resumes_on_another_worker.
